Thanks for the loop, Jonas — quick note from security on pre-req items we typically provide ahead of a hands-on lab: 

Required (before PoC)
- Redacted SOC2 Type II summary (I can attach a 1-page extract)
- High-level data flow diagram (how data moves in and out of the test harness)
- List of IPs/subnets we’ll use (for VPC allowlist)
- Confirmation on whether sample data is PHI/PII (if yes, we’ll need a brief processing attestation)

Optional (helps speed setup)
- Preferred auth method (API key vs short-lived token via STS)
- Any preferred logging retention settings for the session

I’ll attach a short SOC2-summary.pdf and a security pre-checklist to the runbook. If EdgeWave wants to run in their VPC, Marcus and I will coordinate on ports and a small allowlist.

— Soojin Lee
Head of Security, Redwood Inference
